title: 5 copy-paste prompts that save hours

sources.name: Prompt structure: clear instructions and supplied context

caption:
5 copy-paste prompts that save hours of staring at a blank page.
Use these everyday work prompts for email replies, meeting notes, study planning and clearer writing. Give your AI assistant useful context, then check the draft yourself.
Save this for your next busy day. Comment PROMPTS and I will send the prompt list.

slides.headline: Give it the context
body: Name the task, the audience and the result you need.

slides.headline: Reply without rambling
body: Replace the brackets. Check the tone before sending.
slides.prompt: Draft a concise reply to [message] for [recipient]. My goal is [goal]. Use a [tone] tone. Ask me about missing facts.

slides.headline: Turn notes into actions
body: Check every owner and deadline against your notes.
slides.prompt: Summarize [notes] as decisions, action items and open questions. Include owners and deadlines only when stated. Flag anything unclear instead of guessing.

slides.headline: Plan your study week
body: Adjust the plan to your actual available time.
slides.prompt: Build a study plan for [topic] using [materials]. I have [time] before [date]. Include short practice sessions and review. Ask about missing constraints.

slides.headline: Compare your options
body: Use the comparison to think, then make your own decision.
slides.prompt: Compare [options] against [criteria]. List pros, cons and unknowns using only [information]. Show what I should investigate before deciding.

slides.headline: Make the wording clear
body: Read both versions to check that the meaning survived.
slides.prompt: Rewrite [text] in plain language for [audience]. Keep the meaning and necessary details. Use short sentences. Flag wording that could have multiple meanings.

slides.headline: Ask for one revision
body: Point to the part that needs work instead of starting over.
slides.prompt: Revise [section] to be [specific change]. Keep [details] unchanged. Explain any assumptions that still need my input.

slides.headline: Check the draft yourself
body: Treat uncertain answers as questions to investigate.

slides.headline: Save your next starting point
body: Comment PROMPTS and I will send the prompt list.
Share this with someone facing a blank page.
